result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with nothing left. I ran the `Stock*` tests and they passed. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case.

The change is one line in `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`). Its query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, which matches how the other stock overviews filter.

The only caller of that method is `StockService`'s warehouse stock list. I didn't change the single-product quantity lookup, so asking for nuts in WH-1 should still answer 0.
